1.en_consolidated_definition:
Drill press.

Alternatively, in some contexts:

Drill rig or Drill machine.

Note: In Puerto Rican Spanish, "taladro" can also refer to a type of drill used for excavating or drilling into the ground, particularly in construction or mining contexts.
